# Reading the historical sensitivity outputs

- The formatted table in Section 4 is the seven-covariate sensitivity, not the
  new main specification. Column names retain
  the manuscript header (`Covariate`, `Contrast`, `OR general (95% CI)`,
  `OR hospital (95% CI)`, `ROR (95% CI)`, `p`; Cochran Q and I2 retired 2026-10-18); the extra
  `p (Holm)` and `q (BH)` columns are dropped in the manuscript version.
- Section 5 compares two historical adjustment sets; differing complete cases
  and odds-ratio non-collapsibility prevent interpreting changes as mediation.
- Complete-case `n` will differ slightly from Table 4, because rows missing job
  satisfaction are no longer dropped. The printed `n_complete/n_total` in the
  caption is the authoritative denominator for this specification.
- Class numbering is the MANUSCRIPT one (C1 moderately constructive, C2 disengaged,
  C3 constructive and the reference, C4 ambivalent),
  assigned from the behavioral signature by `canonical_class_numbering.R` and
  printed directly by every table above. No hand relabelling is needed any more,
  and the raw `glca` index is never shown. The crosswalk for the current fit is
  printed by the `canonical-numbering` chunk; check it against Table 2 once.


# Principal: psicotrópicos flexibles, sin satisfacción laboral

Esta especificación fue solicitada antes de revisar sus asociaciones. La
comparación no selecciona covariables por P-value. Se presentan estimaciones
ponderadas condicionales al modelo de medición, seguidas de las sensibilidades
históricas ya calculadas. Los intervalos siguientes se basan en la Hessiana;
no sustituyen los intervalos del bootstrap conjunto cuando estén disponibles.

```{r}
#| label: assoc-main-psychotrop
#| results: hold
main_keys <- specifications$main
main_models <- list(
  general = fit_adj(as.matrix(gen_df[, main_keys]), post_g, modal_g, sw = gen_df$.w,
                    ref = ref_class, label = "General (main psychotropic specification)"),
  hospital = fit_adj(as.matrix(hosp_df[, main_keys]), post_h, modal_h, sw = hosp_df$.w,
                     ref = ref_class, label = "Hospital (main psychotropic specification)"))
main_unadjusted_models <- lapply(samples, function(sample) {
  setNames(lapply(main_keys, function(key)
    fit_adj(as.matrix(sample$cov[, key, drop = FALSE]), sample$post, sample$modal,
            sw = sample$cov$.w, ref = ref_class)), main_keys)
})
main_unadjusted_or <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(main_unadjusted_models), function(sample_name) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(main_unadjusted_models[[sample_name]], function(model) model$ors)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample = sample_name)
}))
pair_association_ror <- function(general_ors, hospital_ors, keys) {
  dplyr::inner_join(
    dplyr::select(general_ors, covariate, class, OR_gen = OR, lo_gen = lo, hi_gen = hi,
                  b_gen = b, se_gen = se),
    dplyr::select(hospital_ors, covariate, class, OR_hosp = OR, lo_hosp = lo, hi_hosp = hi,
                  b_hosp = b, se_hosp = se), by = c("covariate", "class")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(logROR = b_hosp - b_gen, seLogROR = sqrt(se_gen^2 + se_hosp^2),
      ROR = exp(logROR), ROR_lo = exp(logROR - 1.96 * seLogROR),
      ROR_hi = exp(logROR + 1.96 * seLogROR),
      ## 2026-10-18 retired (Andres): Cochran Q and I2 removed from all reporting;
      ## with two samples Q = (logROR/SE)^2 only duplicates the Wald test of log ROR.
      # Q = (logROR / seLogROR)^2,
      # I2 = ifelse(Q > 0, pmax(0, (Q - 1) / Q) * 100, 0),
      p_wald = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(logROR / seLogROR)),
      p_holm = p.adjust(p_wald, "holm"), q_BH = p.adjust(p_wald, "BH"),
      Covariate = unname(cov_labs[covariate]), Profile = ms_contrast(class, ref_class),
      inference = "conditional Hessian; independence approximation") |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(covariate, keys), ms_num[class])
}
main_ror <- pair_association_ror(main_models$general$ors, main_models$hospital$ors, main_keys)
main_unadjusted_ror <- pair_association_ror(
  main_unadjusted_or[main_unadjusted_or$sample == "general", ],
  main_unadjusted_or[main_unadjusted_or$sample == "hospital", ], main_keys)
main_formatted <- main_ror |>
  dplyr::transmute(Covariate, Contrast = Profile,
    `OR general (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_adj(OR_gen, lo_gen, hi_gen),
    `OR hospital (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_adj(OR_hosp, lo_hosp, hi_hosp),
    `ROR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci_adj(ROR, ROR_lo, ROR_hi),
    `P-value` = fmt_p_adj(p_wald), `P-value (Holm)` = fmt_p_adj(p_holm), `q (BH)` = fmt_p_adj(q_BH))
knitr::kable(main_formatted, format = "html",
  caption = "Main association specification: weighted ML three-step with flexible psychotropic use and no job satisfaction. General poststratification weights; hospital weight 1. Conditional Hessian intervals; shared-measurement bootstrap reported separately.")
psychotrop_coverage <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(samples), function(sample_name) {
  sample_data <- samples[[sample_name]]$cov
  observed <- !is.na(sample_data$psychotrop_flexible)
  tibble::tibble(sample = sample_name, n = nrow(sample_data),
    original_missing = sum(is.na(sample_data$psicotrop)), flexible_missing = sum(!observed),
    flexible_yes = sum(sample_data$psychotrop_flexible == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_weighted = stats::weighted.mean(sample_data$psychotrop_flexible,
                                             sample_data$.w, na.rm = TRUE),
    effective_n_observed = sum(sample_data$.w[observed])^2 / sum(sample_data$.w[observed]^2))
}))
knitr::kable(psychotrop_coverage, digits = 3,
  caption = "Psychotropic indicator coverage on the measurement-analysis rows; original columns preserved.")
readr::write_csv(main_ror, "table4_main_psychotrop_values.csv")
readr::write_csv(main_formatted, "table4_main_psychotrop_formatted.csv")
readr::write_csv(main_unadjusted_or, "main_unadjusted_or_values.csv")
readr::write_csv(main_unadjusted_ror, "main_unadjusted_ror_values.csv")
readr::write_csv(psychotrop_coverage, "psychotrop_flexible_coverage.csv")
```

# Punto de control y procedencia

```{r}
#| label: assoc-checkpoint-export
#| results: hold
models_by_specification <- list(main = main_models,
  legacy_jobsat = list(general = adj_gen, hospital = adj_hosp),
  legacy_nojobsat = list(general = adj_gen7, hospital = adj_hosp7))
model_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(models_by_specification), function(specification) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(models_by_specification[[specification]]), function(sample_name) {
    model <- models_by_specification[[specification]][[sample_name]]
    tibble::tibble(specification = specification, sample = sample_name,
      n = model$n_complete, n_total = model$n_total, effective_n = model$n_eff,
      weight_sum = model$weight_sum, normalization_mean = model$weight_scale,
      lambda = model$lambda, convergence = model$conv, weighted = model$weighted,
      unpenalized_convergence = model$unpenalized$conv,
      unpenalized_objective = model$unpenalized$objective,
      unpenalized_max_abs_b = model$unpenalized$max_abs_b,
      unpenalized_max_se = model$unpenalized$max_se,
      ridge_triggered = model$ridge_triggered, ridge_reason = model$ridge_reason)
  }))
}))
if (any(model_diagnostics$convergence != 0))
  warning("Hay modelos que no convergieron; revisar diagnósticos antes de interpretar.")
knitr::kable(model_diagnostics[, c("specification", "sample", "unpenalized_convergence",
  "unpenalized_max_abs_b", "unpenalized_max_se", "lambda", "ridge_reason")], digits = 3,
  caption = "Unpenalized diagnostics and the recorded reason for the unchanged ridge fallback.")
triggered_models <- model_diagnostics[model_diagnostics$ridge_triggered, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(triggered_models)) {
  cat("Ridge activated for ", nrow(triggered_models), " of ", nrow(model_diagnostics),
      " sample/specification fits. ", sep = "")
  for (diagnostic_row in seq_len(nrow(triggered_models))) {
    diagnostic <- triggered_models[diagnostic_row, ]
    cat(sprintf("%s/%s: unpenalized convergence=%d, maximum |beta|=%.3f, maximum SE=%.3f; trigger=%s. ",
      diagnostic$specification, diagnostic$sample, diagnostic$unpenalized_convergence,
      diagnostic$unpenalized_max_abs_b, diagnostic$unpenalized_max_se, diagnostic$ridge_reason))
  }
} else cat("No sample/specification fit activated the ridge fallback. ")
cat("Ridge is not Firth correction. Hessian intervals condition on the measurement fit and penalty decision; they do not replace shared-measurement bootstrap or unavailable survey-design information.\n")
stopifnot(nrow(ror_tbl) == 24L, nrow(adj_ror) == 24L, nrow(adj_ror7) == 21L,
          nrow(main_ror) == 24L, nrow(main_unadjusted_ror) == 24L,
          nrow(post_gen) == nrow(gen_df), nrow(post_hosp) == nrow(hosp_df))
asociaciones <- list(
  schema_version = 2L,
  specifications = specifications,
  measurement = list(checkpoint = "02_hospital.RData",
                     hash = unname(tools::md5sum("02_hospital.RData")),
                     model_input_hash = hospital$provenance$model_input_hash,
                     n_init = n_init, seed = 2125L, reference_raw = ref_class,
                     class_key = hospital$tables$class_key),
  covariates = list(general = gen_df, hospital = hosp_df, pooled_raw_scores = combo,
                    keys = main_keys, keys_legacy_jobsat = cov_keys_full,
                    keys_without_job_satisfaction = cov_keys,
                    complete_main = lapply(main_models, function(model) model$rows_complete),
                    complete_8 = list(general = complete.cases(Z_gen8),
                                      hospital = complete.cases(Z_hosp8)),
                    complete_7 = list(general = complete.cases(Z_gen),
                                      hospital = complete.cases(Z_hosp))),
  models = list(main = main_models, main_unadjusted = main_unadjusted_models,
                unadjusted = unadjusted_models,
                adjusted_8 = list(general = adj_gen, hospital = adj_hosp),
                adjusted_7 = list(general = adj_gen7, hospital = adj_hosp7)),
  tables = list(main_ror = main_ror, main_formatted = main_formatted,
                main_unadjusted_or = main_unadjusted_or,
                main_unadjusted_ror = main_unadjusted_ror,
                psychotrop_coverage = psychotrop_coverage,
                unadjusted_or = or_long, unadjusted_ror = ror_tbl,
                unadjusted_formatted = em_tbl, adjusted_ror = adj_ror,
                adjusted_formatted = adj_em_tbl, without_job_satisfaction = adj_ror7,
                without_job_satisfaction_formatted = adj_em_tbl7,
                comparison_8vs7_general = cmp, diagnostics = model_diagnostics),
  provenance = list(created = Sys.time(),
                    input_paths = c(general = gen_path, hospital = hosp_path),
                    input_hash = tools::md5sum(c(gen_path, hosp_path)),
                    code_hash = tools::md5sum(c("../03_asociaciones.qmd",
                                               "../R/canonical_class_numbering.R",
                                               "../R/association_models.R")),
                    session = sessionInfo(),
                    weights = c(unadjusted_general = "survey weights",
                                unadjusted_hospital = "1",
                                adjusted_general = "poststratification weights; mean 1 among model complete cases",
                                adjusted_hospital = "1"),
                    classification_matrix = "unweighted, full measurement sample; weights enter step 3 only",
                    psychotrop_rule = "any yes -> 1; all no -> 0; otherwise NA; original psicotrop retained",
                    psychotrop_recall_window = "not established by item labels; questionnaire confirmation pending",
                    model_helper = "../R/association_models.R",
                    ridge = "lambda=0; fallback=0.1; penalty includes intercepts"))
save(asociaciones, file = "03_asociaciones.RData", compress = "xz")
readr::write_csv(model_diagnostics, "association_model_diagnostics.csv")
cat("Guardado 03_asociaciones.RData; objeto único: asociaciones.\n")
sessionInfo()
```
